infoCategory.title: Chair / Bed Upholstery
infoCategory.description:
Leather chairs, fabric beds and many other elegant upholstery items

The collection of upholstery samples suitable for stools and upholstered chairs, cabinets and comfortable beds come in an extensive variety of elegant shades and high quality materials. The choice of upholstery, from colour to material, allows you to make each model unique and personal and meet your aesthetic and sensory needs. You can choose between soft leather and even softer and finer Glove leather or between smooth leather and nubuck that feels velvety to the touch, or even between faux leather and numerous original fabrics. With each collection, we are committed to selecting new shades and up-to-date upholstery and updating ever-popular ones to create timeless interior design projects.

Leather and hides are natural materials, so an uneven design, wrinkles and marks must be considered a guarantee of authenticity, along with a slight alteration of colour over time.
To care for leather, it is good practice to frequently remove dust that can impede natural perspiration. To remove stains from leather, act promptly with soapy water or cleansing milk. Rinse and dry immediately with a soft cloth. Alcohol, detergents or abrasives should be avoided.
To clean ecological fabrics, we recommend using specific neutral products instead. Do not use brushes, greasy or alcoholic substances that damage surfaces.
